findings.claim: The initial helper never verifies checkpoint commit is an ancestor of remote main; branch="main" inside a JSON checkpoint does not prove publication.
Nonforced ref update is not an expected-old-head compare-and-swap; an ancestor reset after the initial head check can still accept the proposed commit.
Initial helper verifies blob payload but not the returned tree or commit parent before reference mutation; its post-mutation compare can only detect damage afterward.

tests_status: Isolated harness prepared but not run; root requested pause until revised helper.
